overview: CrimeNet is an AI-powered criminal network analysis workstation that unifies FIRs, call records, financial transactions, entities and evidence into one investigative workspace for Indian law enforcement.
features: Command Center with live intelligence feed and case metrics
Interactive criminal network graph with entity intelligence drawer
Case workbench with evidence, network, CDR, money trail and timeline tabs
Financial money trail visualization tracing ₹2.84 Cr across accounts
Command map with movement trails, risk areas and time slider
AI Investigator returning structured findings, evidence and actions
Evidence vault with hash integrity and chain of custody
Security and audit trail with integrity chain
Role-aware dashboards for inspector, supervisor, admin and audit logger
